notes.title: Update 6.27
notes.notes:
Full update notes can be found here.



Update 6.27 should be available on Friday, August 15, between 08:00 UTC and 12:00 UTC. A forced update will follow earliest on Saturday, August 16, at 02:00 UTC.


New Hero: The Croat


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45100116/db32a5d7a28324a96e1b2987febd5187d8a2f043.png"]



The Croat gains a new Skill: forces 1 target enemy within 8 tiles to enter Survival Game for 2 turns. Cooldown: 3 turns.


[p align="start"]Survival Game:

Enemies in Survival Game take +1% damage.

Movement range –2.

During the Survival Game, when attacking enemies with negative status, each negative status increases damage by 2%.

Ends when the target dies or the duration expires. Survival Game is a negative status that cannot be dodged, resisted, or purified.
[p align="start"]At Level 7: If the target dies during Survival Game, The Croat restores 50% HP.
At Level 8: When Survival Game ends, the target is Stunned for 1 turn.
At Level 9: During Survival Game, the target’s Luck is reduced by 150%, and their allies within 3 tiles have their Luck reduced by 50%.
At Level 10: While Survival Game is active, The Croat cannot be killed or put into struggle; instead, he retains 10% HP (max 3 times per activation).
[p align="start"]As a Leader: All team members gain the HP restoration bonus from Survival Game.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Skill: This is an active skill that can be used during combat.

Select a character with Skill, and you’ll see a new command button appear to the right of their portrait.

If the character has a Support, the new button will show up above the support unit instead.


Bug Fixes
Update 6.27

Fixed an issue where the Multishot Launcher and Blazeguard did not get charge points when attacking perforated walkers.

Resolved a bug where dealing more than 2.1 billion damage to a human enemy or walker caused them to restore HP instead.

notes.title: Update 6.25
notes.notes:
Full update notes can be found here.



Update 6.25 should be available on Friday, July 25, between 08:00 UTC and 12:00 UTC. A forced update will follow earliest on Saturday, July 26, at 02:00 UTC.


New Weapons


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45100116/53e3e90bd8b392d079dbfc1e69ea0332bba416a7.png"]



Brace yourselves, Survivors! Our next update is packing two epic weapons you won’t want to miss! We’re not giving everything away just yet, but here’s a hint: both of these armaments come straight from the world of the Daryl Dixon spin‑off series. Can you guess which ones?




Bug Fixes
Update 6.25

Fixed a bug where star counts on the Normal Challenge leaderboard could spike above the 6210 limit.

Corrected an issue where bundle prices showed incorrectly on first login after updating via Steam.

notes.title: Update 6.22 - Reluctant Allies
notes.notes:
Full update notes can be found on our website

Update 6.22 should be available on Friday, May 23, between 08:00 UTC and 12:00 UTC. A forced update will follow on Saturday, May 24, at 02:00 UTC.

A new update is here, bringing new maps for both Challenge and Doomsday Challenge, the introduction of customizable bundles, new equipment scrapping methods, and more!

Added:
- New maps for Doomsday and Normal Challenge, which we'll keep a surprise until we announce their launches
- 'Hyperlink feature' that makes in-game descriptions easier to read with more oversight
- Create your own bundles in the Customized Bundles tab
- Two new methods to scrap your unused equipment for XP
- A new Gold Shop
- Improved Blueprint-claiming in Survival Pass
- Several bug fixes

Fixed:
- Fixed the Full Supplies showing “-1” due to localization issues
- Fixed the M1 Inferno’s placeholder image
- Fixed UI refresh issues when switching languages and in Challenge stage selection
- Fixed a small UI glitch with the Free Bundle icon in camp.
- Fixed Double XP banner blocking the closing button on 7-day login
- Fixed missing icon for Magna’s token in Black Market
- Fixed an issue where the 7-day beginner’s task for weapon scrapping didn’t count as completed

notes.title: Update 6.21 - Dead City Season 2
notes.notes:
Full update notes can be found on our website

Update 6.21 should be available on April 29 between 08:00 UTC and 12:00 UTC. A forced update will follow on April 30 at 02:00 UTC.

In this update, Perlie Armstrong is added as a new Hunter hero, Hilltop Maggie gets a new skin, enjoy 8 new Season Missions, and more!

Added:
- Dead City's Perlie Armstrong (Hunter) joins the roster of heroes
- Hilltop Maggie gets a new skin called Moonlight Maggie
- Eight missions are added for the second season of Dead City, available each Monday after an episode
- A new Doomsday Challenge mapset, but we haven't yet decided when to release it

Fixed:
- Fixed the issue that BlazeGuard couldn’t ignite the main target
- Fixed the issue where attacking perforated enemies with the Pickle Jar did not gain charge points
- Fixed the issue in combat where pairing Fighter Rosita with Gauntlet Aaron could cause infinite attacks

notes.title: Update 6.20 - Legacy Reforged
notes.notes:

Added:

- Bundle store optimization (gradually released)

- Fixed the issue where the Star Hero bonus wasn’t effective after restarting the game.
- Fixed the issue where Blast Grenades didn't stun upon collision anymore.

notes.title: Update 6.18 - Iron Will
notes.notes:
Full update notes can be found on our website

Update 6.18 should be available on March 4 between 08:00 UTC and 12:00 UTC. A forced update will follow on March 5 at 02:00 UTC.

In this update, Gauntlet Aaron is introduced as a Warrior hero, equipment upgrade times are removed, and more!

Added:

- Resource acquisition shortcuts (the '+' in the top-menu)
- Equipment upgrade times are removed

- Early level changes for guilds, tutorial, and ignoring resource limits 

Fixed:
- Fixed the bug where Last Stand Extra didn't start if certain heroes were still Outpost defenders
- Fixed the bug where players couldn't leave inactive guilds
- Fixed the values of teammates' assist attacks during charge attacks while Yumiko was a leader
- Fixed the Doomsday Challenge buff issue where the actual buff was different from what was selected
- Fixed overlapping labels and overlapping text sections
- Fixed Hilltop Coin amount disappearing after entering Workshop and going back to Camp
- Fixed an issue with Negan's Deal's Last Stand attempts
- Fixed the issue where the Apocalyptic Guardian Armor didn't share its Apocalyptic Trait with teammates

notes.title: Update 6.17 - Greene Family's Pocket Watch
notes.notes:
Full update notes can be found on our website

Update 6.17 should be available sometime between January 24 (10:00 UTC) and January 26 (14:00 UTC).

In this update, Riot Gear Glenn (Bruiser) receives his Heirloom, Maggie (Hunter) is being buffed, our Challenge Star issue is fixed, and more!

Added:
- Heirloom for Riot Gear Glenn (Bruiser)
- Buffs for Maggie (Hunter)
- Itinerary; categorizing new features as part of bigger UI optimization
- New Doomsday Challenge maps
- Added Blueprint icons to the Item List
- Optimized the Seasonal Mission order for starters
- Enabled heroes deployed in Outpost available in other in-game battles

Fixed:
- Fixed the issue with Challenge Stars exceeding the limits and further affecting the Leaderboard.
- Fixed the issue with Fighter Rosita with an infinite attack to the walkers within the range when running out of Action Points.
- Fixed the issue with Gore not functioning when Fighter Rosita attacked and had 0.5 action points remaining.
- Fixed the issue with the missing icon when using the max Speed-up token for Survivor upgrade.
- Fixed the issue with the wrong gas icon when running out of Gas.
- Fixed the issue with the game not responding after clicking My Data in Settings - Account & Services.
- Fixed an issue with the PPK’s ‘Bone Crusher’ status.

notes.title: Update 6.15 - Negan's Deal
notes.notes:
Update 6.15 is planned to be available on Saturday, November 30, 2024, around 22:00 UTC (could be earlier). After the weekend, you aren't able to play without having updated.

Our new update consists of:
- New mode: Doomsday Challenge
- New feature: Negan's Deal
- New feature: Morgan's Clear

Some of the update's contents will be available later, but read all about the full update by clicking the link above!

Read all about it on our website

notes.title: Update 6.13 - The Book of Carol
notes.notes:
Our next update is now live. Let's go over its summarized contents!


 Brand new missions based on The Walking Dead: Daryl Dixon Season 2 - The Book of Carol
 Protector Daryl joins the game as the latest Bruiser hero, including shields and taunting
 Last Stand's Decontamination feature ensures an easier Last Stand experience
 Equipment Remodeling allows you to reroll traits on all the weapons and armor you have
 Equipment Breakthrough allows you to upgrade Apocalypse gear to get ready for future difficulty increases
 Daryl's Harpoon is the first original Apocalyptic Bruiser weapon
 The Shielded Fortress Armor is the first armor with an actual Special Functionality
 We have resolved the Apocalyptic Token issue by introducing Universal Apocalypse Tokens
 Some small bug fixes, with more to come later
 New Campaign


Check out the update notes on our website!
